page.layout: One column of running text, left of centre, with a wide empty space to its right. No marginal notes. Running head "NOTÆ." with page number "51" at top right. Catchword "cenorum" at bottom right and signature "H 3" at bottom left.

main_text.p: Abd Manapho natus in linea recta هاشم Hafhem, qui populi sui princeps fuit, ac primus الرحلتين [?] i. e. binas pabulatorum catervas, æstivam, &c. & hyber-nam, quarum in Alcor: fit mentio, apud eos instituit. Extra lineam 1. عبد شمس Abd Shems qui pater امية Ommaiya, à quo Ommawaide, è quibus Othman Ebn Affani. Nec-non Moawiah Ebn Abi Sofyan, & Merwan.
1. المطلب AlMotallab, à quo المطلبيون Motallabidæ. E quibus fuit Antistes sectæ Shafiensis, &c. Mohammed, Ebn Edrü, Ebn il Abbas, Ebn شافع Shafei, &c.

3. ذو فل Nawfal, A quo النوفليون Nawfalidæ. Hashemo natus in linea recta عبد المطلب Abdol Motallab. eAbdo'l Motallabo عبدالله Abdollah, in linea recta. extra lineam omnes patrui Mohammedis, &c. حمزة Hamzah, العباس AlAbbas, à quo Chalifæ Abbasidæ genus ducunt. ابو طالب Abu Taleb pater Alii, ابو لهب Abu Labeb. الغيداق AlGidak, الحارث AlHareth, جحل Jabel, المقوم AlMokawan, ضرار Ddorar. الزبير AlZobair, قثم Ketham, عبد الكعبة Abdo'l Caaba. Abdollahi filius Mohammedis, qui natus anno الفيل i. e. Elephanti, quæ Arabum ante Hejram Epochæ.

Atque hæ præcipuæ sunt Arabum antiquiorum tribus. Ego certe Maimonidi inter eos qui non magni sint momenti, quibusque pervolvendis non multum insumi debeat temporis, libros, إنساب العرب i. e. Origines Arabum numeranti facile assenserim, quas tamen hoc loco qua potui fide ex Ismaele Abulfeda & Shahaboddino Ahmede Ebn Yahya aliisque ut referrem eo inductus sum, quod scribit ille, qui Chronicon Saracenorum

page.notes: Arabic words are copied as far as legible; the spelling of the Arabic names, especially الرحلتين, is doubtful and not verified letter by letter. Italic and roman distinctions in the Latin are approximate. The page has no marginal notes. The bottom line "cenorum" is taken as the catchword.
